answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 24716 Country: India Title: Sometime back I saw a dream and I would be grateful if u could give me tabeer for the same. I saw that I am standing just outside my house in the lane. Some lions are approaching me from the other end. I am a little scared. But when they come close to me, the lions become meek and submissive. And I realise that though I was afraid of them, they are actually here to help and protect me. Soon, I see these lions stand next to me to counter the lions coming from the opposite direction. Pl guide with a tabeer. Question: AAWW! Sometime back I saw a dream and I would be grateful if u could give me tabeer for the same. I saw that I am standing just outside my house in the lane. Some lions are approaching me from the other end. I am a little scared. But when they come close to me, the lions become meek and submissive. And I realise that though I was afraid of them, they are actually here to help and protect me. Soon, I see these lions stand next to me to counter the lions coming from the opposite direction. Pl guide with a tabeer. Answer ID: 24716 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1257/1006/D=1431) It indicates towards safety from the enemies. In-sha-Allah, you shall be saved from the wickedness of enemies with Allah’s protection. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
